## Earnie 2.6.0-alpha.2

Community **pre-release** of the **2.6** line (follows `2.6.0-alpha.1`). Includes installation-hardening Sprint 1–3 code on `main` (**2.6.j** / **2.6.k** / **2.6.l**). Pin this tag — **no** `:latest`.

### Highlights

- **2.6.l network (H9 / H10 / H8)** — `EARNIE_LAN_SUBNET` + Docker-subnet gate + Supervisor `/network/info`; last Miniserver callback on `:8541` in SB / EHAL-Com; bridge → HA URL + long-lived token on Smarthome-Backend
- **2.6.k** — release channels (LoxBerry stable/prerelease/pinned, HA `earnie_prerelease`, GHCR `:next`, QEMU smoke)
- **2.6.j** — add-on/LoxBerry safeguards (H12 stopgap, H3/H5/H7); H0 preflight still deferred until after **2.6.m**; H11 Gen2 HTTPS verify still open

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.6.0-alpha.2` and `:next` (**no** `:latest`)
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.5.3**).

HA add-on: pre-release channel only (`earnie_prerelease`) — official `earnie` is not updated by this tag.
